description: Nine lines, not yet in the book

participation.context: Counted the sheets and left them unbound.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the nine are his additions, not yet in the book

story.body: You counted nine passages still in your own hand and wrote that they go into the book on Wednesday, not before. You did not strike the tables. You did not copy a joke into the book.

relations.note: the nine are his additions, not yet in the book

title: Counted the nine lines and set them for Wednesday
